item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your evening already has a wind-down built in: a check-in, then progressive muscle relaxation, then a set bedtime. That structure is the asset, so protect it. The risk is letting the day's loose ends follow you into bed. Use the check-in to write down what's unfinished, so your mind can put it down. Keep your bedtime fixed, even tonight. Action: when the relaxation reminder goes off, put your phone away.
